# Austin Kovach — Industrial Designer

Austin Kovach is an industrial and product designer in Bedminster, New Jersey, with a BFA in Industrial Design from Montclair State University. His work focuses on product design, concept development, user interaction, 3D modeling, rendering, prototyping, model making, and visual communication.

## Selected projects

- Pipamoka: a travel coffee maker redesign exploring grip, portability, durability, and brand language.
- E-REV3: a three-wheel urban mobility concept focused on accessible, affordable, and sustainable transportation.
- Haven: a modular transit shelter with adaptable panels, weather protection, seating, and rider information.
- Half-inch Impact: an Ingersoll Rand industry collaboration focused on pneumatic tool ergonomics, housing architecture, controls, and lighting.

## Education and experience

- BFA in Industrial Design, Montclair State University, 2022–2026.
- Massachusetts College of Art and Design, 2021–2022.
- Ingersoll Rand industry collaboration, January–May 2025.
- Movado industry collaboration, August–December 2024.
